frames.title: Awake since 4. Out the door at 8.

slides.title: "Are you skipping again?"
slides.body: What to say when a partner or friend asks.

slides.title: It isn't skipping
slides.body: Skipping is avoiding a decision. You made one.

slides.title: "I'm doing a 15-minute walk instead."
slides.body: A modified plan is still a plan.

slides.title: "I checked what today can support."
slides.body: You don't owe a longer defence.

slides.title: Said out loud, it stays closed
slides.body: No reopening it at lunch. No double session tomorrow.

slides.title: Decide it, then say it
slides.body:
The Morning Capacity Check and a printable decision card.
